dependencies.name: typesafe
dependencies.notes: Original TypeSafe skills; API calls require credentials.

dependencies.name: router
dependencies.notes: Interactive MCP App and CLI for explicit Codex routing advice, editable mappings and local history. Does not automatically switch the conversation model.

dependencies.name: jev-belay
dependencies.notes: Collects native Codex prompt/tool events and reuses upstream evidence classification and completion decisions. Does not parse or edit live transcripts.

dependencies.name: fast-jev-output
dependencies.notes: Upstream native Codex wrapper; opt-in noninteractive stdout pruning, not an interceptor for every shell call.

dependencies.name: fast-jev-compaction
dependencies.notes: Runs the upstream compaction library on explicitly exported normalized messages and prints a separate artifact. Does not replace live Codex history or trigger native compaction.

dependencies.name: jev-rules
dependencies.notes: Selects .codex/jev-rules markdown via upstream selection and rendering; supports prompt and patch events. Claude pane and automatic codebase-map UI are not included.

dependencies.name: jev-guard
dependencies.notes: Upstream native Codex hooks; requires Jev credentials. Codex sandbox remains authoritative; upstream ask decisions are warnings.

dependencies.name: andrej-karpathy-skills
dependencies.notes: Original Karpathy guidelines skill; license declaration preserved in skill frontmatter.
